## Managed File Header Requirement

Every Concert-managed file in this repository **MUST** include the version header in the first 15 lines:

```
AUTO-GENERATED BY CONCERT vX.Y.Z
```

### When does this apply?

- When **creating** a new file in any managed path listed below
- When **modifying** a managed file that is missing the header (add it)

### Managed paths

All files in these directories are managed and require the header:

- `.claude/agents/concert-*.md`
- `.claude/commands/concert/*.md`
- `.claude/rules/*.md`
- `.claude/skills/*/SKILL.md` and all files under `.claude/skills/*/references/`
- `.github/agents/concert-*.agent.md`
- `.github/workflows/concert-*.yml`
- `.concert/templates/*.md`
- `.concert/stage-registry.jsonc`

### Header format by file type

**Markdown files** (`.md`):

```markdown
<!-- AUTO-GENERATED BY CONCERT vX.Y.Z — DO NOT EDIT. This file is managed by Concert and will be overwritten on `concert update`. -->
```

NOTE: For agent files under `.github/agents/`, the header should be placed **after** the YAML front matter, not before.

**YAML files** (`.yml`):

```yaml
# AUTO-GENERATED BY CONCERT vX.Y.Z — DO NOT EDIT. This file is managed by Concert and will be overwritten on `concert update`.
```

**JSONC files** (`.jsonc`):

```jsonc
// AUTO-GENERATED BY CONCERT vX.Y.Z — DO NOT EDIT. This file is managed by Concert and will be overwritten on `concert update`.
```

### Why this matters

The `cleanupStaleFiles()` function during `concert update` scans managed directories and deletes files whose header version doesn't match the current version. Files **without** the header are treated as user-created and left alone — but Concert-managed files without the header will never be cleaned up if they are later removed from the source, leaving stale files in target repos.
